message: The lounge at OR Tambo turned me away saying my membership tier doesn't cover it, but I've used it before. Flight in 2 hours.
I was told the lounge was full and to come back in an hour. My boarding is in 45 minutes.
Staff refused my digital card and insisted on a physical one, which I never received.
They wouldn't let my two kids in with me even though my plan includes guests.
I can't log in to the app to see my membership card. The password reset email never arrives.
My card shows the wrong name. It still has my maiden name on it.
When does my membership renew? I'd like to switch to the plan with unlimited visits.
The QR code on my digital card won't scan at any lounge. It's been like this since the app update.
You charged my card for a guest visit, but I was travelling alone that day.
I was billed in dollars instead of rands and my bank added a foreign transaction fee.
I'd like a refund for the unused months after I cancelled in August.
Please send me a VAT invoice for my annual membership fee.
The Wi-Fi in the Cape Town lounge didn't work at all and I missed an important call.
There were no seats available and people were standing with their bags everywhere. Very disappointing.
Lovely lounge in Dubai, the shower facilities were spotless. Keep it up.
A staff member was very rude to my elderly mother at the reception desk.
Please change my mobile number on my account, I have a new one.
I want to know what personal information you have stored about me and who you share it with.
Please remove my old credit card from my profile and close my account.
Are you partnered with any car hire companies at the airport?
I'd like to suggest you add a lounge at King Shaka airport in Durban.
I had an allergic reaction to food in the lounge that wasn't labelled properly and needed medical help.
If this double charge isn't refunded by Friday I'm reporting you to the consumer ombudsman.
I use a wheelchair and the lounge said they couldn't accommodate me, so I was left at the gate for 3 hours.
